_comment: Scholium collateral facts. Every piece reads from this file; build.py regenerates them all. Colours and type: docs/design.md sections 2-3. Copy: docs/homepage/index.html (cited per line). Region AU: the pieces are printed in Australia (90 x 55 mm card, A-series paper).

business.tagline: Signed, open preprints and peer review

hero.text: The preprint, signed. The review, open. The record, kept.

lede.text: Scholium is a free preprint and peer-review network. Every paper, version and review carries its author’s signature, so anyone can check who wrote what, and when, without taking anyone’s word for it.

items: Free to read and to publish

provenance.head: Signed by you. Checkable by anyone.
provenance.body: Your passkey unlocks a signing key that lives on your device. Scholium never sees it.
provenance.source: homepage Provenance h2 + 'Your key stays yours.'

review.head: Peer review, out in the open.
review.body: Formal reviews sit in the margin beside the paper, scored against a public rubric. Anyone can read them.
review.source: homepage Open review h2 + first two sentences

record.head: Take the record with you.
record.body: Export any paper, with every version, signature and review, as a single archive. It verifies offline, on your own machine, with no help from Scholium.

authors.head: Publish in minutes. Prove priority for good.
